profile.headline: Software Engineer | 15+ Yrs Exp | Python, PHP, AWS | Scalable API Architecture & Team Leadership| Authorized to work in the U.S.
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned Software Engineer with over 15 years of international experience designing highly scalable, data-driven systems. I specialize in bridging complex engineering requirements with strategic business value—a capability recently validated by PhD-level leadership, who identified me as a standout candidate for technical leadership roles.

I currently leverage my deep technical background at The Home Depot, where I have been recognized as high-potential internal talent. In under a year, I earned four Homer Awards for Building Strong Relationships and Creating Shareholder Value. I was also named Associate of the Month and serve as a Certified Equipment Trainer, entrusted with peer mentorship and operational safety.

𝗖𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗶𝗲𝘀:
  • 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽: Proven Technical Team Lead with a strong track record of mentoring engineers and advancing modern development practices.
  • 𝗕𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗲𝗻𝗱 𝗔𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲: Deep expertise in Python (FastAPI, Django) and RESTful API design, delivering resilient solutions for complex applications and smart-device integrations.
  • 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱 & 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: AWS Certified Developer – Associate, specializing in serverless architectures, data integration, and system optimization.
  • 𝗕𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁: Highly effective at translating technical roadmaps into measurable outcomes, including driving a 70% reduction in manual data entry through automation.

I am a Lilburn, GA resident, 𝗳𝘂𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀, and eager to bring my global experience and demonstrated success at The Home Depot to a high-performing engineering team.

positions.title: Software Developer & Systems Integration Specialist
positions.description:
• Led integration work to consolidate Bennett Graphics' fragmented order, production, and inventory systems — Infigo, Gelato, Tharstern MIS, and Canon/HP Indigo press APIs — into a single operations platform.
• Ran bilingual plant-floor discovery sessions with production and bindery operators to identify gaps in job-status tracking and material requisitioning, informing a material ledger and workflow-state model.
• Architected a shipping orchestration platform integrating UPS, FedEx, and USPS APIs with automated label generation, cloud storage, audit trails, and event-driven shipment tracking.
•Automated the shipping and label pipeline, accelerating order processing by more than 50% while improving shipment accuracy.
• Engineered material-consumption integration between Canon/HP Indigo presses and Tharstern MIS, eliminating incorrect inventory deductions from unreliable substrate matching.
• Migrated internal print workflow services to a Docker container via Docker Compose, preserving press API callbacks, with systemd handling recovery and health checks.
• Deployed a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner to automate test execution and Docker build verification on every pull request, catching regressions before merge.
• Built a SemVer-driven release automation pipeline that validates tag ancestry, builds multi-arch images, pushes to GHCR, deploys by immutable image digest, and runs post-deploy health checks with automatic rollback on failure.
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Integration Architecture · Software Architecture · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Python Programming · Python (Programming Language) · Docker · Docker Products · GitHub · GHCR · Tharstern MIS · Systems Integration · Containerization · Event Driven

positions.title: MET Associate
positions.description:
• 4x Homer Award Recipient (2025): Consistently recognized by Store, District, and MET leadership for Building Strong Relationships and Creating Shareholder Value.
• Associate of the Month (March 2025): Selected for driving operational excellence and team execution in a high-volume environment.
• Certified Equipment Trainer: Lead safety and operational training for Order Picker, Reach Truck and Electric Ladder certifications; mentor new associates on safety protocols and complex equipment operation.
• Strategic Transition Management: Successfully established a U.S. professional footprint by maintaining top-tier operational performance while delivering remote backend engineering solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Developer
positions.description:
• Architected and scaled a comprehensive Transportation Management System (TMS) utilizing Yii2 (PHP), Python, and MySQL to centralize freight logistics, carrier management, and dispatch operations.
    • Secured multi-tenant logistics operations by implementing MVC architecture combined with role-based access controls (RBAC) and encrypted authentication systems.
    • Engineered high-performance RESTful APIs in Python to automate data scraping and real-time integration with FMCSA, ELD providers, and factoring companies, reducing manual data entry by over 70%.
    • Developed automated email processing modules via Gmail API integration, streamlining thread management and attachment handling directly within the TMS platform to reduce manual administrative overhead.
    • Automated complex data synchronization workflows between internal logistics modules and third-party vendor APIs, ensuring 100% data integrity across the platform.
    • Managed software version control using Git/GitHub, implementing efficient release deployment practices that significantly decreased release errors and system downtime.
    • Optimized system performance by refactoring legacy code and tuning database queries, resulting in a measurable reduction in average API response times.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Gmap · MySQL · Third-Party Billing · Git · REST APIs · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Yii · Python (Programming Language) · ELD(electronic logging device) · jQuery · Gmail · Database Systems · API Development · JavaScript Frameworks · PhpStorm

positions.title: Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
• 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽: Evolved from Software Engineer to Technical Team Lead, bridging the gap between technical architecture and business needs to deliver robust smart-energy solutions.
• 𝗔𝗣𝗜 & 𝗠𝗼𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗲 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Architected Python/FastAPI RESTful APIs for Intelligent Building Management Systems (IBMS), integrating smart hardware interfaces via NODA and TADO.
• 𝗠𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 & 𝗕𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗣𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗲𝘀: Mentored peer developers in modern OOP patterns and advanced development practices, significantly improving team delivery velocity and code quality.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer | Human Resources
positions.description:
• Full-Stack Platform Architecture: Designed, developed, and deployed a comprehensive Training Management System utilizing the LAMP stack (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP) and jQuery.
• Mobile Ecosystem Development: Engineered a dedicated mobile application for management using Flutter, integrated via a custom PHP REST API to ensure real-time data synchronization with the core training platform.
• Modernization & Responsive Design: Implemented critical vocational training functionalities using Laravel and Bootstrap, prioritizing responsive UI/UX and high-efficiency data.
• End-to-End SDLC Management: Directed the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from initial requirements gathering and technical translation to final system implementation and performance tuning.
• Agile Leadership & Mentorship: Provided expert mentorship on secure software development best practices. Actively led Agile/Scrum processes, including sprint planning and complexity-based task estimation to ensure on-time delivery.
• Clean Code Standards: Translated complex user requirements into maintainable, high-performance code, focusing on long-term system scalability and security.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer | Network Operations Security
positions.description:
• Architected an End-to-End Fraud Detection System: Developed a robust platform to analyze Call Detail Records (CDR) using Python (Django, Pandas, PyMongo) and MongoDB, significantly improving the identification of fraudulent calling patterns.
• Advanced Data Analytics: Leveraged Pandas for data preprocessing and statistical analysis to execute anomaly detection, uncovering hidden patterns and enabling proactive fraud mitigation strategies.
• Full-Stack Implementation: Designed a responsive and intuitive front-end interface using Bootstrap, ensuring complex analytical data was accessible and actionable for end-users.
• Scalable Engineering: Transformed complex business requirements into high-performance, maintainable code, optimizing database queries via PyMongo for large-scale telecom datasets.
• Impact-Driven Results: Supported decision-making by automating the detection of suspicious network activity, reducing financial risk and operational overhead.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer | Provisioning and Traffic
positions.description:
• Engineered a Call Behavior Indicator (CBI) system utilizing PHP (Laravel) and MongoDB to analyze Call Detail Records (CDR). Designed and implemented complex algorithms to track critical metrics including call frequency, average duration, and national/international traffic ratios.
• Architected a Service Management System for DSLAM infrastructure using Laravel, MySQL, and Python. This system streamlined network monitoring, troubleshooting, and service provisioning, significantly enhancing infrastructure reliability.
• Automated Data Collection by developing and integrating Python scripts, reducing manual data gathering time and improving the accuracy of real-time network reporting.
• Modern Development Standards: Standardized the use of Git for version control across projects, ensuring code integrity and facilitating seamless team collaboration.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
• Enterprise System Architecture: Directed the design and development of a comprehensive Personnel Control System utilizing Symfony, PostgreSQL, and ExtJS, streamlining HR operations and data tracking.
• Information Management Solutions: Led the end-to-end development of an integrated information management system using Zend Framework and PostgreSQL, focusing on data integrity and high-performance query execution.
• Full-Stack Development: Engineered sophisticated user interfaces with ExtJS, creating high-performance, desktop-like web applications for complex data entry and reporting.
• Technical Leadership: Managed the software development lifecycle (SDLC) for multiple projects, overseeing database schema design, backend logic, and frontend integration while ensuring code quality across the team.

positions.title: Systems & Network Administrator
positions.description:
• Infrastructure Architecture: Engineered and optimized enterprise Linux environments (Ubuntu, Debian, SUSE), ensuring high availability for critical network services including DNS, DHCP, and NFS.
• Traffic & Proxy Management: Configured and optimized Apache HTTP Server and Squid Proxy to manage high-volume web traffic, implement content filtering, and improve network performance across the organization.
• Automation through Scripting: Authored an extensive suite of Bash shell scripts to automate critical system operations, including automated data backups, disk health monitoring, and system status reporting.

projects.description:
RetailGuard is a 𝗰𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱-𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 machine learning system built on 𝗚𝗼𝗼𝗴𝗹𝗲 𝗕𝗶𝗴𝗤𝘂𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗠𝗟 that detects both problems using a hybrid analytical approach combining:

  • Supervised fraud detection
  • Unsupervised anomaly discovery
  • Behavioral feature engineering
  • Operational analytics visualization
